title: Towards a Trustworthy and Governable Internet of Agentics: An Architectural Perspective on Protocols, Systems, and Services
title_zh: 迈向可信赖、可治理的智能体互联网：协议、系统与服务的架构视角

paragraphs.en: 从服务计算视角审视智能体互联网,梳理协议栈、系统抽象与治理信任的三层演进架构。 Large language model applications are increasingly being organized as tool-using and multi-agent workflows rather than as isolated chat interfaces. This perspective paper examines the architectural problem that follows from that shift: agents may reason, invoke tools, and delegate work, but dependable deployment still requires interoperability across frameworks, runtimes, data boundaries, and organizational control domains. We study this problem through the lens of the \emph{Internet of Agentics} (IoA), an emerging service-computing view in which heterogeneous agents are treated as governable service participants rather than only as stand-alone model endpoints. The paper organizes the landscape as a three-layer progression: from today's fragmented agent ecosystem, to interoperable agents, and ultimately to trustworthy and governable autonomy. First, it examines the protocol stack centered on the Agentic AI Foundation, including MCP for agent--tool interaction; A2A for agent--agent coordination; AGENTS.md and Skills-style procedural manifests; and discovery, transport, and trust mechanisms such as AGNTCY and SLIM. Second, it reviews the systems abstractions that make agents deployable as service components, including logical agent architectures, orchestration patterns, gateways, registries, runtime control loops, and hardware-aware inference infrastructure. Third, it situates these developments within services computing, arguing that agentic systems reinterpret classical concerns from SOA and microservices---discovery, composition, governance, pricing, and trust---at the level of cognitive capabilities rather than deterministic functions.
paragraphs.zh: 从服务计算视角审视智能体互联网，梳理协议栈、系统抽象与治理信任的三层演进架构。大语言模型应用正越来越多地被组织为使用工具和多智能体的工作流，而非孤立的聊天界面。 这篇观点论文审视了这一转变所引发的架构问题：智能体可以推理、调用工具并委派工作，但可靠的部署仍需要跨框架、运行时、数据边界和组织控制域的互操作性。 我们通过“智能体互联网”（Internet of Agentics, IoA）的视角研究这一问题，这是一种新兴的服务计算观点，将异构智能体视为可治理的服务参与者，而不仅仅是独立的模型端点。 本文将该领域的全貌组织为一个三层演进：从当今碎片化的智能体生态系统，到可互操作的智能体，最终实现可信且可治理的自主性。 首先，本文考察了以 Agentic AI 基金会为核心的协议栈，包括用于智能体与工具交互的 MCP；用于智能体间协调的 A2A；AGENTS.md 和 Skills 风格的程序化清单；以及诸如 AGNTCY 和 SLIM 等发现、传输与信任机制。 其次，本文综述了使智能体可作为服务组件部署的系统抽象，包括逻辑智能体架构、编排模式、网关、注册表、运行时控制回路以及硬件感知的推理基础设施。 第三，本文将这些发展置于服务计算的语境中，论证智能体系统在认知能力而非确定性函数的层面上，重新诠释了源自 SOA 与微服务的经典议题——发现、组合、治理、定价与信任。
